text: Can you please tell me if the patient is awake and responding normally, and whether they have any severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now?
He is not responding normally; he is only speaking confused words. He has no chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding.

sources: ESI v5 p.12 (New Onset Confusion, Lethargy, or Disorientation)

text: Based on what you just told me, please call 995 NOW if you are not already with paramedics. I have put this at the top of the hospital report.
Could you please tell me what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale of 0 to 10?

He collapsed while doing heavy outdoor work after about four hours with very little water. He has no head injury, but he is currently confused, very hot (40.4°C), and weak enough to only respond with confused words; I do not know the pain level or his medical history.
Since you haven't answered yet, could you please tell me when the confusion started and rate his pain from 0 to 10?
The confusion started after he complained of headache, nausea, and dizziness before falling. He is not in pain; he is confused and responding only with confused words.

writes: after he complained of headache, nausea, and dizziness before falling

text: Did you notice their face drooping on one side, an arm going weak or numb, or slurred or strange speech at any point today?
No, I did not notice facial drooping, arm weakness, or slurred speech. He only became confused and fell after complaining of headache, nausea, and dizziness while working in the sun.
Could you please tell me if he takes any regular medications?
I do not know his medications. He has no known medical history or allergies.
Could you please tell me if he is currently pregnant, recently gave birth, or has a weakened immune system?
I do not know his medical history, allergies, or medications. He is male and there is no indication he is pregnant or recently gave birth.
Could you please tell me if he has had a rash, traveled overseas in the last two weeks, or come into contact with anyone who is infectious?
I don't know about rashes, travel history, or contact with infectious individuals. We do not know his medical history or allergies.
Could you please tell me when he last ate or drank, as well as his name and date of birth for the hospital's records?
He had breakfast at 7am and has been drinking very little water over the past four hours. I do not know his name or date of birth.
